name: Castiel
source:
Castiel is one of the students attending Sweet Amoris High. He is a member of the basketball club and a rock band, along with his best friend, Lysander and his rival, Nathaniel. Castiel is legally independent, as his father works as an airline pilot, and his mother as a flight attendant. Due to their jobs, they are not home often, which has caused Castiel to be more comfortable without them, rather than in their presence.

Likes: his electric guitar, Winged Skull, Demon (his dog), girls who are able to stand up for themselves
Dislikes: being forced to do something, taking orders, cats, Nathaniel
